1.q: What is an International Driving Permit companion document?
1.a0: An International Driving Permit companion document is a multilingual document that presents your driver license information in an internationally understandable format.
1.a1: It is generated based on your real driver license and is designed to be used together with your original license when traveling abroad.
1.a2: It helps authorities and car rental agencies interpret your license details more easily.

2.q: Is this an official government-issued International Driving Permit?
2.a0: No. This is not a government-issued International Driving Permit.
2.a1: It is a companion document designed to accompany your original driver license and provide a multilingual presentation of your license information.
2.a2: You must always carry your original driver license when using the companion document.

3.q: Why is a companion document useful for international travel?
3.a0: Driver licenses issued in one country may not be easily readable in another due to language differences or unfamiliar formats.
3.a1: A companion document presents your license information in multiple languages, making it easier to understand abroad.
3.a2: This can be helpful when renting cars or presenting your license during travel.

4.q: Do you check my driver license details?
4.a0: Your companion document is generated from the information on your real driver license.
4.a1: You upload your license so our software can automatically process the details and generate the document accurately.
4.a2: This helps ensure the document reflects your actual license details.

5.q: How long does it take to receive my companion document?
5.a0: In most cases, your companion document is generated within minutes after submission.
5.a1: You will receive it as a digital PDF file that you can download immediately.
5.a2: You can print it or keep it on your phone for convenience.

6.a0: You will receive your companion document as a digital PDF file.
6.a1: It is optimized for both printing and mobile display.
6.a2: You can access it anytime after download.

7.a0: Yes. Your data is processed securely and used only for generating your companion document.

7.a2: All document generation is handled automatically through secure systems.
